entities.summary: Robert A. Wood was an American basketball guard who played in the National Basketball Association (NBA). Wood grew up in Rockford, Illinois, he played with the Sheboygan Red Skins during the 1949–50 NBA season. In his one NBA season, Wood averaged 1.2 points per game and 0.2 assists per game.
